contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS NN NOB C ; R/ CAESARVM NOSTRORVM

Copper alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I as Caesar (317-337), minted in Trier, and pierced at 12 o'clock and 6 o'clock. obv legend: CONSTANTINVS NN NOB C obv type: laureate head facing right. rev legend: CAESARVM NOSTRORVM rev type: wreath around VOT X. Finder's number 10
